notes: finish_reason=length alone does not establish total-context exhaustion. All listed HumanEval/BFCL cap hits generated exactly the requested output limit while total usage remained below 65536.
Context guard stops occur before the next model request: history plus reserved output cannot fit. They are not interrupted in-flight completions.
Output-limit hits do not necessarily fail grading: one historical HumanEval and two historical BFCL cases still passed.
